issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台从源码抓到 12f，改版前视频只有开场闪光，卡片还没飞出来就结束了
卡面是灰色骨架条加 2px 灰边的占位卡，卡背是灰色斜条纹，和精致的蓝色星芒完全不在一个档次
卡片按 380 宽栅格化后放大 1.88 倍定格，近满幅的定格帧文字和细节发软
纯 #000 黑场没有任何层次，定格后的 2 秒是死黑底上一张卡
白卡上的 overlay+screen 扫光会把深色文字洗成浅灰
changes: 导出 MAGICIAN_CARD_FLOURISH_DURATION = 126（闪光 9f + 飞行 50f + 定格展示与扫光 67f）；闪光、弹射、自旋、定格这些用户逐轮定过的参数一律不动
卡面换成出版级海报卡：品牌行（徽记 + Aurora + NEW），深蓝星光主视觉呼应开场星芒，标题 30/副题 17 设计号，作者行与 CTA；卡背换成深海军蓝加交叉细纹章和中心徽记；2px 灰边改为发丝线加内高光
卡片按定格尺寸布局、CSS zoom 栅格化，飞行中只缩小、透视距离同比放大，定格帧原生锐利（Q2）
暗场换成带冷色相的近黑径向底，加暗角和颗粒；定格后卡后亮起一团极淡的蓝色环境光
扫光改为 soft-light 加弱 screen，深色主视觉上看得出光泽，白卡上的文字不被洗白；定格段撤掉 CameraMotionBlur（画面冻结，结果相同，渲染省 7 倍）
issuesEn: No exported duration constant: the workbench scraped 12f from the source, so the before video shows only the opening flash and ends before the card flies out
The card face was a gray skeleton placeholder with a 2px gray border and the back was gray diagonal stripes, far below the polished blue star flash
The card was rasterized at 380px wide and scaled 1.88x for the freeze, so the near-full-frame hero frame was soft
A pure #000 field with no depth, so the 2s after the freeze was one card on dead black
The overlay+screen sheen washed the dark text on the white card into light gray
changesEn: Exported MAGICIAN_CARD_FLOURISH_DURATION = 126 (9f flash + 50f flight + 67f freeze and sheen); the user-tuned flash, launch, spin and freeze parameters are untouched

The face is now a publication-grade poster card: brand row (mark + Aurora + NEW), a deep-blue star artwork echoing the opening flash, a 30/17 design-size title and subtitle, and an author row with CTA; the back is deep navy with a crosshatch guilloche and a center emblem; the 2px gray border is now a hairline with an inner highlight
The card is laid out at freeze size and rasterized via CSS zoom, so the flight only ever scales down (with perspective scaled to match) and the freeze frame is natively sharp (Q2)
The dark field is now a cool-hued near-black radial with vignette and grain, and a faint blue ambient glow rises behind the card after the freeze

The sheen is now soft-light plus a weak screen layer: visible gloss on the dark artwork without bleaching text on the white card; CameraMotionBlur is dropped during the freeze (the frame is frozen, so output is identical and rendering is 7x cheaper)
